(1) SOUND PARTS: #38 = X + eps pays for a medal only if I < 0 AND eps > 0 AND rank(X+) <= bronze. eps cancels whenever I >= 0, and at eps = 0 a tie goes to the earlier copies. Round 15's 'bronze ~#394 lies inside the 0.953 block' (v_recheck_r15-rc-c) used PUBLIC ranks at 05:31Z and ignored growth: 358 teams are at >= 0.954 now and 520-690 are projected. So 'above the block ~ medal' now needs part of the crowd to fall below X on private. That correction is real and belongs in the record. (2) WHY THE NUMBER FAILS: P(iii) = P(rank(X+) <= bronze) is almost a step function of beta, the mean share of a public-variant margin kept on private. Every field in the r16fc-2 MC has beta >= 0 (overfit 0-0.10, mid 0.10-0.25, central 0.2-0.35), so 'P(iii) 0-0.35' is conditional on public tweaks not overfitting on average. I ran an independent check (scratchpad r16fc4_check.py, same field counts, growth r 0.6/1.0, finals correlation rho 0.6/0.9, genuine share 0.1/0.3). It gives P(iii) = 0.66-1.00 at beta -0.30, mostly 0.9-1.0 at beta -0.15, 0.00-0.87 at beta 0, and 0.00 at beta >= +0.15. Negative beta is not excluded by our own evidence: DC dc0.30 was lab +0.0013 but public -0.005, and the edge filter was +0.016 local but 0 on LB, so public-tuned knobs can flip between embryos. The Mamarin base rate (public-best wins private ~3/4, discussion 743006) leans to beta > 0 but is not decisive. So the twin's value is ~0.01-0.04 if beta >= 0, and up to ~0.33 x 0.5 x 1.0 ~ 0.16 if beta < 0. '~0.06 upper bound' is not a bound. (3) THE COMPARISON IGNORES A CORRELATION: the worlds where #38 still matters (beta < 0) are the worlds where a public-tuned upside u (DC 0.20/0.225, fm45) is most likely negative on private. So 'independent u worth +0.02..+0.15 in ~77% of worlds' overstates the swap value exactly where the swap costs something. (4) I-092: MC outputs were rejected twice as decision inputs. A single model number handed to the user as 'only ~0.01-0.06' will be read as a bound. It pushes toward the I-298 shape for classes A/B, which needs a re-tick, while the one fact that decides it (beta) is unobservable before 30 Sep. Feasibility is trivial (info only: no build, submit or rule change).
